title: Long John Silver's Style Coleslaw
description: A sweet, tangy fast-food-style coleslaw dressing blended smooth with an immersion blender and tossed with cabbage mix.

ingredients.name: buttermilk
ingredients.note: or 1/3 cup milk plus 1 1/2 tsp vinegar

steps.title: Add dressing ingredients
steps.text: Add {mayo}, {sugar}, {milk}, {buttermilk}, {lemon}, {vinegar}, {onion}, {salt} and {pepper} to a tall container.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend with an immersion blender until completely smooth and slightly thickened. This hydrates the dried minced onion instantly and gives a silky, fast-food-style dressing.

steps.title: Dress
steps.text: Pour about 80 percent of the dressing over {cabbage}.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Toss thoroughly and let sit for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Adjust
steps.text: Add the remaining dressing until it reaches your perfect creaminess.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Chill for at least 1 hour. Overnight is best.

notes: Dressing for 2 1/3 quarts of cabbage mix. It makes a slightly generous amount, which is intentional.
